title: Strict-local models with a separably closed coefficient field and algebraic residue extensions
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $Y$ be a scheme of finite type over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\bar y$ be a geometric point with underlying point $y$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $b=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], [def-weil-residue-field], and $S=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar y}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. There exist an affine open neighbourhood $U$ of $y$ in $Y$, a separably closed field extension $L/K$ with $\operatorname{trdeg}_K L=b$ [def-kun-separably-closed], and a small cofiltered inverse system (the opposite index category is filtered as defined in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]) $(V_i\to U)$ of nonempty affine schemes with affine transition morphisms over $U$ [def-pc-scheme], such that each $V_i$ is of finite type over $L$, the maps $V_i\to U$ are $K$-morphisms, and $S\cong\varprojlim_i V_i$ over $U$ (that is, the compatible maps $S\to V_i$ are universal among compatible cones). For every $i$ and every point $v\in V_i$ with image $u\in U$, the induced extension $\kappa(v)/\kappa(u)$ is algebraic (each element satisfies a nonzero polynomial over $\kappa(u)$).
